entry: BACKTRACE/BACKROOMBench (arXiv:2607.27484): Causal intervention framework exposing a "Reasoning Backroom" in skill-augmented agents — gap between stated skill attribution and actual causal influence. In multi-agent settings, skill influence survives communication even after source is lost; no-skill teams hallucinate skill attribution. Standard observational detectors (LLM judge, trace similarity, text mentions) all fail. Audit requires intervention, not observation. Directly relevant to multi-agent reliability and provenance governance.
